summary: Ran node syntax validation, static Worker/UI/API review, direct Turso regression tests, and public-host smoke checks. The Worker source and Turso read-only checks pass, but the configured public host serves the React shell rather than the embedded Worker dashboard.

critical.issue: A write-capable Turso bearer token is committed in source and Wrangler vars; rotate it and use a Wrangler secret with no source fallback.
Public host returns the generic React shell, not the Worker light-theme dashboard, so the requested Worker deployment/UI cannot be verified through the user-facing URL.

minor.issue: Regression test still opens removed /app/cloudflare-worker-d1.js and is stale; it is skipped here because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is unset in the test process.

integration_issues.issue: Configured public host renders React starter/application HTML without ShinDora Worker markup; source-only UI implementation is not connected to the public route.

action_items: Rotate and remove the exposed Turso token; configure TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN as a Wrangler secret.
Deploy/reroute cloudflare-worker.js to the configured public hostname and verify /, /dashboard, /api/links, and /api/stats there.
Update stale test_cloudflare_worker_d1_review.py to read cloudflare-worker.js.
critical_code_review_comments: Do not ship database bearer credentials in JavaScript or wrangler.toml [vars].
The embedded dashboard uses unescaped database fields in innerHTML and inline handlers; escape titles, URLs, slugs, and IDs before rendering to avoid stored-XSS/injected markup.

success_rate.backend: 100% (3/3 focused Turso tests passed; 3 deployment tests skipped)
success_rate.frontend: Not tested (backend-only request; public host mismatch observed)

seed_data_creation: None; read-only Turso queries and GET smoke checks only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: node --check cloudflare-worker.js passed. Turso returned 271 rows in direct pipeline tests; public host returned 272 links and stats 272/104/167/0 but served a generic React shell at / and /dashboard. Stream/download missing-target checks returned 400. No APIs were mocked.
rca of the issue: The repository contains a standalone Cloudflare Worker implementation, while REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL points to an Emergent preview host routing root/dashboard to the existing React app. This indicates deployment or ingress wiring mismatch rather than a syntax failure in the Worker source.
